7.1.9.9.2 Assembling the Dlt Extended Header
[SWS_Dlt_00691] ⌈If the parameter DltUseExtHeaderInNonVerbMode is set to
TRUE, the Dlt Extended Header has to be generated for Dlt Data Messages:⌋()
[SWS_Dlt_00692] ⌈The VERB bit shall be set to ’1 ’if the parameter DltUseVer-
boseMode is set to TRUE. Else, the VERB bit shall be set to 0.⌋()
[SWS_Dlt_00693] ⌈The MSTP field shall be set to 0x0 if the Dlt message has to be
assembled due to the API call Dlt_SendLogMessage.⌋()
[SWS_Dlt_00694] ⌈The MSTP field shall be set to 0x1 if the Dlt message has to be
assembled due to the API call Dlt_SendTraceMessage.⌋()
[SWS_Dlt_00695] ⌈The MTIN field shall be set accordingly to the Dlt_MessageLogInfo
Typ value, which has been passed by the API Dlt_SendLogMessage.⌋()
[SWS_Dlt_00696] ⌈The MTIN field shall be set accordingly to the Dlt_MessageTrace
InfoType value, which has been passed by the API Dlt_SendTraceMessage.⌋()
